sacraments.text: Next infant baptism 13 December 2026, 13:30 Main Church Hall; preparation 28 November and 5 December, 09:00–11:00 St Anne’s Hall Level 3. Submit completed form and documents at least two weeks before baptism; late submissions deferred. No infant cap, but incomplete documents not accepted.

2026/27 journey Tuesdays 20:00, preceded by praise 19:45, St Joachim’s Hall Level 4. Proper journey began 7 April; Search ran 3 February–24 March. Registration deadline 20 January is past. Physical forms at Secretariat Level 2; welcomes non-Catholics, baptised Christians and new Catholics; no obligation to be baptised.
Ministry to the Sick supports homebound parishioners with Communion, anointing and reconciliation, also visits Sengkang General Hospital; annual Mass for the sick.

Ministry of Consolation provides wake prayers for one night or more if possible, funeral Mass/service coordination, and committal support at crematorium. Monthly columbarium prayers last Sunday after 11:30 Mass.
